# Coursera

> > Coursera is a global online learning platform offering courses, professional certificates, and accredited degrees from top universities and industry partners including Google, IBM, Meta, and Microsoft.

Coursera partners with 300+ universities and companies to provide accessible, flexible education across data science, business, computer science, and other fields. The platform features specialized programs like Coursera Plus (unlimited access to 10,000+ courses), Guided Projects for hands-on learning, and fully accredited online degrees including the University of Illinois iMBA.

## Key Topics

- Coursera Plus
- Google Professional Certificates
- IBM Skills
- Meta Certifications
- Python Programming
- Data Analytics

- University Partnerships
- Coursera Coach (AI Assistant)

## Platform Overview

- [About Coursera](https://about.coursera.org): About page: company vision for accessible world-class learning
- [Coursera Homepage](https://coursera.org): Homepage: online courses and certificates from Google, IBM, Meta, Adobe
- [How Coursera Works](https://coursera.org/about/how-coursera-works): Platform overview explaining Coursera's learning paths and course types
- [Coursera Plus](https://coursera.org/courseraplus): Coursera Plus subscription: unlimited access to 10,000+ courses from Google, Meta
- [Guided Projects](https://coursera.org/campus/guided-projects): Guided Projects for campus: hands-on tutorials with Power BI, Docker, Tableau

## Course Catalog

- [Browse All Courses](https://coursera.org/courses): Course catalog featuring Google AI, Data Analytics, and Professional Certificates
- [Browse by Topic](https://coursera.org/browse): Browse courses by category: data science, business, computer science, health
- [WordPress 101 - The Complete Guide](https://coursera.org/learn/packt-wordpress-101-the-complete-guide-lgzu2): WordPress complete guide course by Packt: themes, plugins, SEO optimization

## Online Degrees

- [Online MBA (iMBA) - University of Illinois](https://coursera.org/degrees/imba): AACSB-accredited iMBA from University of Illinois: no GMAT, pay-per-course
- [Executive MBA - IIT Roorkee](https://coursera.org/degrees/emba-iitr): Executive MBA from IIT Roorkee: 24-60 months, 100% online with double specialization
- [BSc Business Administration - University of London](https://coursera.org/degrees/bsc-business-administration-london): BSc Business Administration from University of London via Royal Holloway

## Learning Guides & Roadmaps

- [How to Learn Artificial Intelligence](https://coursera.org/articles/how-to-learn-artificial-intelligence): Beginner's guide to learning AI: fundamentals, tools, and Google AI Certificate
- [Docker Learning Roadmap](https://coursera.org/resources/docker-learning-roadmap): Docker learning roadmap: containerization basics to DevOps and cloud workflows
- [C# Learning Roadmap](https://coursera.org/resources/c-sharp-learning-roadmap): C# learning roadmap: .NET frameworks, ASP.NET Core, and Azure development
- [How to Create a Study Guide](https://coursera.org/articles/create-a-study-guide): Tutorial on creating study guides using active learning and AI tools
- [Benefits of Online Learning](https://coursera.org/articles/benefits-of-online-learning): Article on online learning benefits: flexibility, cost savings, global access

## Frequently Asked Questions

- [Cybersecurity FAQ](https://coursera.org/articles/cybersecurity-faq): Cybersecurity FAQ: career guidance, skills, certifications, and job outlook
- [Project Management FAQ](https://coursera.org/articles/project-management-faq): Project management FAQ: skills, certifications, and Google PM Certificate
- [Master's Degrees FAQ](https://coursera.org/articles/masters-degree-faq): Master's degree FAQ: requirements, duration, salary comparison, and types
- [What Is Cloud Computing?](https://coursera.org/in/articles/what-is-cloud-computing): Cloud computing FAQ: basics, infrastructure, public/private cloud concepts
- [What Is Git?](https://coursera.org/articles/what-is-git): Git FAQ: version control basics, GitHub comparison, and developer workflows
- [What Is an API?](https://coursera.org/articles/what-is-an-api): API FAQ: types (REST, SOAP), endpoints, and integration with ChatGPT, YouTube

## Tutorials & How-To Guides

- [Excel Structured Reference Tutorial](https://coursera.org/articles/excel-structured-reference): Excel tutorial: structured references in tables and formula syntax
- [How to Make a Graph in Google Sheets](https://coursera.org/articles/how-to-make-a-graph-in-google-sheets): Google Sheets tutorial: creating and customizing graphs for data visualization
